name: hikoutei
description: Typed repository and safe write layer for Google Sheets-backed MVPs. SQLite-authoritative entity lifecycle with asynchronous Google Sheets projection.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && npm run build -w @hikoutei/storage && npm run build -w @hikoutei/sheets && npm run build -w @hikoutei/sync-engine && npm run build -w @hikoutei/composition && npm run build -w @hikoutei/cli && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/ci/reconcile-contracts-dist.mjs && node scripts/ci/smoke-contracts-bundle.mjs && npm run build -w spreadsheet-db-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck:test: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/ikisaki/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck -w @hikoutei/storage -w @hikoutei/sheets -w @hikoutei/sync-engine -w @hikoutei/composition -w @hikoutei/cli
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && npm run build -w @hikoutei/storage && npm run build -w @hikoutei/sheets && npm run build -w @hikoutei/sync-engine && npm run build -w @hikoutei/composition && vitest run
scripts.audit:deps: npx depcruise src packages/contracts packages/storage packages/sheets packages/sync-engine packages/composition packages/cli --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err
